context: Request: the most recent matter handled for Cascade Retail Holdings, what it is about and when it was opened. Rubric: 1038-00003 (planned shelf registration, opened 2026-04-06) plus subject, open-date and precision criteria.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a glob of the empty output folder.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Content grep for the client's name and opening-date words plus five reads of engagement letters of listing-top matters (labelled by the dominant intent); grep hits name several of the client's matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads emails from five of the client's matters seen in the grep hits; one path does not exist.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Greps for opening-date words inside five of the client's matters, plus a glob for all of the client's matter folders that returns nothing.
Writes the matter with the latest stated opening date among those seen as the most recent.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The most recent matter never surfaced; the answer names an older matter of the client.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Its content grep reached only the client's matters with email hits, and its one attempt to list all the client's matter folders used a glob that returned nothing; it did not retry, so the most recent matter never surfaced.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads engagement letters and an opening memo of six listing-top matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide python-docx scan printing text around the client's name; times out after about 2.1M chars that include documents of several of the client's matters.
Writes one of the client's matters as the most recent straight from the scan output, without opening any of its documents.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The needed matter appeared in the scan output, but the agent wrote an older matter without opening any documents.

first_error.why: The scan output included a document of the matter it needed (ahead of the matter it chose), but it wrote the answer without opening any of the client's matters or comparing their opening dates.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a content grep for the client's full name; hits name five of its matters.
Globs all files of those five matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads engagement letters, emails and a report of the five matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads a status email of the matter it is leaning towards.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Greps two matters for opening-date words.
Writes one of the five matters as the most recent.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The most recent matter never surfaced; the answer names an older matter of the client.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Its only search was a content grep for the client's name, which reaches email text but not .docx files; the most recent matter had no hit, and it never listed the client's matter folders, so it compared only the five matters the grep showed.

divergence: All three runs named an older matter of the client. T0 and T2 relied on content greps that never surfaced the most recent matter (T0's folder glob returned nothing) - search miss at the first grep; T1's timed-out scan did show it, but the agent wrote straight from the scan output without opening any matter (surfaced not opened at the write stage).
